narr: A cold front moved through the region triggering thunderstorms. Some of the storms became severe with numerous reports of large hail.
ev: Up to three inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding. State Highway E was flooded in several locations between Bellflower and Jonesburg.
lsr: MONTGOMERY COUNTY SHERIFFS OFFICE REPORTED MISSOURI STATE HIGHWAY E WAS FLOODED BETWEEN JONESBURG AND BELLFLOWER.
